entries.en: The only thing I can say for that plant is it made me forget how hungry I am.
I prefer hunger to slavery, thank you very much.
You've done so much, Shepard. Thank you.
Nothing will stop us now. We'll tame this world.
They said we'd never last on Feros. We'll prove them wrong.
I didn't think we would get through this, but there's good times ahead.
We've lost it all, and we didn't have much to begin with.
No point in staying now. This place just isn't viable.
Another failed colony.... This won't play well at home.
Survival is something. You know about that, don't you, Shepard.
Feros is done. Even you war heroes know you can't win all the time.
I suppose we should be thankful for surviving. You've done clean-sweeps before, haven't you?
There, there, dear, you'll get through this. Just relax.
I'll be glad when I'm out of this place. I hate what happened here.
Nothing we did here was for us. We lived a lie even before the Thorian took us.
My headaches... are getting better. I just have to... stop thinking about the past.
Hello, offworlder. I'm glad that we aren't totally forgotten by the rest of the galaxy.
Dear, please try to rest. You're not ready to speak.
But they should know... unh.... I mean, they are very important.
Yes, that's better.
I am... fine. I just need to try to think clearly. It's just a lingering pain from... from the last attack. I'll be fine.
I can't see any significant damage, but something is clearly causing her pain.
Please, just let her rest. She just needs... rest.
I see no major injury, but something must be causing her pain.
I can't see anything significant, but something is clearly causing her pain.
She looks whole, but something's clearly causing her pain.
She is not visibly injured, but clearly, something is causing her pain.
It hurts so much when I think about what we've lost.
So many have died.... We should.... Unh.
We should flee.... No. We can't do that.
I can't think of a reason to leave. I can't think....
Thank you for everything you tried to do here.
Finally. We have hope again.
It was in my head. Like getting slapped every time your eyes left the ground.
I don't know if I want to stay, but I'm glad we have the choice.
Is there anything I can do for you?
I'm not going to catch anything from you, am I?
I hope you're not contagious.
Yes... goodbye.
I need... rest.
Your help is appreciated, but we're not out of the woods yet.
We can take care of feeding ourselves now, but the geth are still a problem.
The geth are still our greatest concern.
You're the one who repelled that last wave.
They'll be back. And if the geth don't kill us, we'll die of hunger soon enough.
I need to boost rations with varren meat, but it's too dangerous.
I can't do anything until he's dead.
Excellent. I'll organize a hunt when the immediate threat of the geth is gone.
Of course. I don't want to delay you any more than I already have.
On the positive side, they'll attack anything. Even those damn synthetics.
The big alpha varren is the real problem. He's mad, erratic, completely unpredictable.
The colony is growing, or it was.... But you should speak with Fai Dan. He is our leader.
Hunting them is impossible while fending off the geth.
I'd rather you concentrated on the geth. Food won't help us if they breach our defenses.
It-- It doesn't hurt any more! I can think my own thoughts again.
We have a chance to start over, thanks to you.
That's great! I mean, varren tastes horrible, but with the geth gone, I can organize a hunt.
Thank you for not abandoning us like everyone else.
And with company money coming in, there's no need to choke down varren meat.
Thanks for everything. We owe you our lives.
Have you given any thought to helping us with our food shortage?
Thank you for your help. You've already done so much.
That would only help us in the short-term, unless you plan to make a trip every few days. We need to be self-sufficient.
Thank you for everything you did.
Thanks to you, Greta and I can start over.
The Thorian controlled us with pain.
I never expected this much trouble. I guess that's what makes it a frontier world.
I suppose you tried. Too bad it wasn't enough to save the colony.
It is a shame all our efforts were for nothing.
Why was everything stacked against us? We had so much hope for this colony.
We don't need to worry about food. We're all leaving soon enough.
Are you doing anything to remedy the situation?
I killed the big varren. The rest are yours.
Fork over the reward so I can get back to more important things.
Why should I speak with Fai Dan? Why can't you tell me?
Tell me about hunting varren.
I have a ship. I could bring in supplies from offworld.
I took out what looked like the oldest of the varren. The rest are yours.
Can't you and the others hunt on your own now that the geth have been removed?
I'll look into it when I get a chance.
I could ferry in more than enough food to cover your immediate needs.
Just pay up.
Hunting varren
You tell me.
I killed a varren alpha male.
Why not do it yourself?
I'll help if I can.
I could fly food in.
You need food?
The alpha male is dead.
I could fly supplies in.
Food is still our immediate concern, but we'll manage.
Varren are dangerous, especially an established pack. We've lost so many people already.
I'm sorry, maybe it's just me. I need some time to get myself together.
She's gone. We've lost everything and Greta is gone. I'm sorry. I just don't want to talk right now.
I don't want to talk about that right now. Speak with Fai Dan.
What's to tell? I came here with my wife Greta, looking for adventure, a new life together.
This isn't exactly what we signed up for.
Of course, it would be much better without the geth. We were really starting to enjoy the colony before they came.
The geth are mounting another attack.
If the geth don't kill us, the lack of food just might.
They'll be here any minute.
I don't know if I can handle another attack.
Here, for your trouble. It's not much, I know, but it's all we can spare.
The alpha varren -- he's huge and he's mad. Rabid, maybe. Totally uncontrollable.
I'll hold this position in case those things try to attack again.
I'm not the best shot, but I'll do what I can.
I'll try to keep an eye on things. I don't know how long we can hold out while their command post is intact.
I want to help, but this is all I can do. I have to stay here, no matter what.
When I could think, I hoped more of us would survive.
You'll have to excuse me. My thoughts are with Davin, not the colony.
I just want to go. The colony was our adventure together, Davin and I.
Thank you for freeing us.
The Thorian forced me to think what it wanted. I felt when you killed it.
That thing got into my head pretty deep. It hurt so much....
I'm glad we'll have another chance here. That's all Davin and I have ever wanted.
Davin and I have had enough. We're getting out while we still have each other.
Oh no. We're heading back to Earth. The sooner Feros is a memory behind us, the better.
Those geth are bloody dangerous.
If I had a credit for every geth I've killed....
Keep alert. They'll be here any minute.
Desperate times call for desperate measures.
You're the commander of the ship that just landed.
Not originally. The captain died in one of the geth raids. I'm the last crew member.
We shouldn't even be here. The salarian merchant promised us a fortune.
There's too much damage. Maybe if the geth stopped attacking I could fix her.
Then again, if there were no geth, I might just stay on a while.
I'm just watching over the ship. Making sure she doesn't get any worse.
Good luck out there.
Hello again. Is there something I can do for you?
Thanks, Commander. It's great to be free again.
It was hell, you know? Any honest thought hurt, just like staring at the sun.
You did a good thing for Feros, but I'm getting out while I can. I've had enough of the colony life.
I'm ready to go back to Earth. Things are simpler there.
Well, you tried, Commander. More than most would have.
I guess the colonists will miss this place. Not me.
Are you the captain of this freighter?
What's wrong with the ship? Isn't she spaceworthy?
Ship's owner
Can you fly it?
If nothing else, she's good for hiding in when those geth come over the walls.
The geth can't be allowed into the heart of the colony.
They'll... they'll be here any minute.
This is my post. I must defend it at all costs.
I must prepare for the geth attack.
I can't talk right now. I'm busy.
I can't be distracted. Please go.
This work must be completed.
I can't. This is not a good time.
I wish.... I suppose it could be worse.
